label: UNITING-CAUSE_3
paraphrase: UNITING-CAUSE_3 (also BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_3). OPEN premise: nothing causes its own being (no x with CausesIn x x esse). Stated by De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch numbering), 'aliqua res seipsam in esse produceret, quod est impossibile' (claim 85857e47). The esse instance of STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-PERFECTION; unlike that rival it is not refuted by a subject causing its proper accidents (navigation: ST I q.3 a.4 denies that a thing's essential principles suffice for its esse).
